Game Overview

At its heart, Whack Your Ex is a flash game about unleash your creative revenge in a hilariously cathartic setting. Transform breakup frustrations into laughter as you explore absurd scenarios for each ex-related dilemma. Let the quirky animations and exaggerated situations brighten your mood in this fun-filled, stress-relieving adventure.
